create.name: Sivananda Yoga Vedanta Centre Tel Aviv
create.bio:
Sivananda's Tel Aviv centre opened in 1971 as a branch of the International Sivananda Yoga Vedanta Centres, the organisation founded by Swami Vishnudevananda, and it has grown into one of Israel's main schools of classical yoga. It describes itself as an urban ashram rather than a studio: a three-storey building on Leteris Street in central Tel Aviv, run as a non-profit association in which the managers, teachers and reception staff all serve as volunteers in the spirit of karma yoga. Thousands of Israelis have trained as Sivananda teachers through the wider organisation, and partner centres operate in Mata, Eilat and Herzliya.

The weekly timetable runs from morning to evening, with classic ninety-minute classes, shorter hour-long sessions, gentle classes and advanced practice that ends in meditation. Newcomers start with an eight-session introduction to the postures, breathing, relaxation and yogic diet, then continue to second- and third-level courses. Further courses cover meditation and japa, positive thinking, the philosophy of yoga and Patanjali's Yoga Sutras, and the centre trains teachers to lead yoga on chairs and for children. Senior teachers from the organisation's ashrams lead weekend retreats in the city, and some classes and courses are also offered online.

courses.title: חפשי ללא הגבלה לחודש (unlimited monthly pass)
courses.description: Unlimited open classes for a month by standing order, covering the centre's classic, short, gentle and advanced Sivananda classes. A ten-class card and single classes are also sold; booking ahead through the centre's app is required.

courses.title: יוגה 1 – מבוא לשיבננדה יוגה
courses.description: An eight-week introduction to classical Sivananda practice, one meeting a week, building from the five principles, yogic breathing and relaxation through the sun salutation, kapalabhati and alternate-nostril breathing to the headstand. Morning and evening groups start through the year.

courses.title: ריטריט עירוני נובמבר 2026 עם רוקמיני צ׳יטניה
courses.description: A two-day city retreat at the Tel Aviv centre led by Rukmini Chaitanya, a senior teacher from the Sivananda ashram in the Bahamas, with yoga classes, meditation, chanting, talks on sustaining inspiration in practice, and vegetarian meals.
